segments.text: Welcome back to GitHub awesome. This is GitHub trending skills episode 3. 35 open source skills trending on GitHub right now. Let's get into it.
Nine ARM skills is one engineer's personal clawed code skill library. A debugging discipline that forces you
through reproduce, trace, falsify, cross reference before touching any code. A postmortem writer that refuses to draft until you have a real repro and a
validated fix. A scrutinized skill for outsider perspective PR review and a management talk rewriter for when engineers need to brief leadership.
Paper spine is a claude code and codec skill for rewriting academic papers properly, not a pros polisher. It first
locks in the paper's controlling motivation, studies the target journal or conference, learns rhetorical structure from strong exemplars, then
builds section blueprints and a rewrite matrix before touching a single paragraph. Three Python steadlib scripts handle style metrics, revision auditing.
You buy a 600page technical book, read three chapters, then never open it again. Booktoskill flips that. It's a
clawed code skill that turns any technical book PDF into a clawed code skill of its own. Drop the PDF in, get back a structured, queryable skill your
agent can study, reference, and apply while you actually work. Your bookshelf becomes your AI's training material.
Every Electron app feels like an Electron app. Raycast doesn't. Native feel distills exactly how Raycast pulls
that off into an installable agent skill. Eight architectural tenets, a four-layer architecture pattern, a web kit and web view 2 survival guide, and a
75 item ship audit, all reverse engineered from Raycast 2.0 and beta.app.
drop it into cloud code and build cross-platform desktop apps that don't betray themselves the moment someone touches them.
Service graph is a set of agent skills that give your AI a structured directory of over 100,000 US professional services
firms, law, marketing, SEO, IT, consulting, accounting, and more. Filter by industry, location, size, rating, and
third party listing presence without scraping a single page.
The four tier funnel keeps discovery free and anonymous. Contact info costs quota only when you've actually shortlisted someone.
PPT design prompt is a small Python CLI that converts web first brand designMD files into presentation imageoriented
design guides for PowerPoint, Keynote, and PDF decks. Point it at your local brand source files. Run design MD PPT
convert and it writes reformatted outputs to PPT image SL with a conversion manifest. Not a deck generator, not a screenshot scraper,
just a clean bridge between brand docs and image model inputs.
Power design is a claude skill for generating HTML slide decks that don't look like AI made them. You give it a brand URL and it pulls the design DNA
via firecrawl or you pick from 72 pre-built brand systems including Stripe, Linear, Apple, and Versel. Every
slide is then checked against 20 codified design principles from Tuy, Darte, Refactoring UI, and WAG. One idea
per slide, 40% whites space, eight point grid, data ink ratio above 80%.
Louis Rossman's team published the writing rules they used to keep Claude from producing AI slop. It's a portable
Claude MD plus two skills. 24 hard anti-slop rules covering band words, filler phrases, dramatic headings,
hollow, it's not X, it's Y constructions, and the M dash problem, plus a voice profile built from corpus analysis of 513,000 words of Rossman's own writing.
Charlie Hills open sourced the Claude skill system behind his 350K follower, 100 million view per year content operation.
17 skills total. Voicebuilder interviews you and writes your voice profile. Then every other skill reads it before drafting a word. Postwriter, hook
generator, postcorer against your actual history via appy real script reverse engineering YouTube thumbnail generator analytics dashboard content matrix.
Got a startup idea? Before you spend three months building it, run it through this. The Codeex startup pressure test skill finds your core assumption,
exposes fatal flaws, checks whether the problem is real, maps current behavior and real competitors, plans your first
10 customer moves, and defines a twoe MVP test. One Npx install and it's in codeex. Run it brutal mode if you want
the full hit. Google AI overviews and AI mode are changing what SEO actually means. And this agent skill package is
Google's official guidance into something your AI agent can act on. Audit pages for AI search readiness.
Turn advice into a prioritized implementation plan. Check crawability, structured data, media SEO, e-commerce
details, and get myth busting on AEO hacks and LLM.ext.
If you're building agent skills and want to actually measure whether they work, agent skills eval is the tool for that.
It's a TypeScript SDK and CLI that loads agentskills.io style skill folders, runs them with and without the skill for a
baseline comparison, grades outputs with a judge model, and generates a static HTML report with pass rates, token usage, timing, and assertion evidence.
Any search is a unified real-time search skill for AI agents. General web search, 23 vertical domain searches, parallel
batch search and full page content extraction in one package.
Works with clawed code cursor and windsurf. The CLI runs on Python, Node.js, PowerShell or Bash and auto detects your runtime on first run.
Anonymous access works without an API key though rate limits are tighter.
AI generated UIs all look the same. Hero section, three features, CTA, footer, repeat forever. Hallmark is an anti-AII
slop design skill for claude code and codecs. Pick a macro structure, dress it in one of 22 themes, run 65 slop test
gates, plus a pre-emit self-critique before anything ships. Two pages built by Hallmark for two different briefs feel like different sites, not color swaps of the same template.
Open Mobius is a full ICT and smart money concepts trading knowledge skill for Claude codeex openclaw and Hermes.
Your agent now speaks the language of institutional trading from market structure and displacement to precision entry models. If you're building quant
tools on top of ICT or SMC methodology, this is the missing domain knowledge layer.
Robotics Skills Suite is a massive curated collection of 76 audit ready clawed skills for industrial robot,
cobot, AMR and ROS2 life cycles. 38 specialized builders autonomously generate ISO 12100 risk assessments, RO2
architectures and IEC 62443 cyber security segmentation into formatted Excel workbooks. 38 matching reviewers.
Cross-check the math. Enforce biomechanical limits for cobots. Verify CLR ratings.
You recorded two hours of podcast or stream footage. And now someone has to find the clips. Clipify makes that claude codes problem instead of yours.
It's a Claude code skill that automatically finds the funny or interesting moments in a long video, cuts them, refframes the footage to 916
with face tracking, and burns opus style captions.
Drop in a video. Get back social ready short clips. No manual scrubbing. No separate editing app.
HTML and canvas is the official motion repo demoing the new HTML and canvas API using Chromium's experimental draw
element image to capture DOM elements and composite them through custom WebGL shaders. Claude Code drives the whole thing in the demo. If you build
programmatic video with remotion and want GPU powered visual effects on your HTML content, start here.
Agent Figure Gallery is a drop-in scientific plotting skill for clawed code, codecs, cursor, and other agents that teaches them to produce publication
quality figures by default. Correct access labels, clean layouts, proper color choices, the kind of output you'd actually put in a paper or presentation.
Drop it in once, every chart your agent generates gets better.
Most anti-h hallucination prompting is just telling the model to be careful.
Buddhist method is a clawed code skill that encodes Buddhist epistemic principles as an engineering discipline.
Direct observation over assumption, tracing errors to their actual root cause rather than treating symptoms, and
staying steady under the pressure of a deadline or a panicking user.
Android testing skills is a set of skills covering compose UI tests, Android instrumented tests, JVM unit
tests, and ADB from Skyovves, the author of several well-known Android libraries.
Drop them into cloud code or codecs and your agent writes tests that actually understand the Android testing stack. If you build Android apps with AI, this is the missing layer.
Every academic journal has its own voice, structure, and unwritten conventions that reviewers notice immediately when violated. Journal adapt
writing skill is a clawed skill that reads published papers from your target journal, extracts the writing convention section by section, then revises your
manuscript to match. Actual journal specific adaptation, the kind that signals to reviewers that you understand the venue.
You've got years of video footage scattered across multiple drives and no way to find anything in it. Frameex turns that archive into a queryable
knowledge base. It's a clawed code skill that generates a sidecar markdown file next to each clip with GPS location, a
speaker diorized multilingual transcript, English translation, face detection, and an AI scene description with a keep review or callull rating.
Working in automotive, autonomous vehicles or embedded EV software, automotive skill suite is the 150 plus
skill counterpart to that robotic suite we covered. Getting vehicle software legally certified for the road is a nightmare of compliance and safety
standards. This automates the entire life cycle. Installable cloud skills covering ISO 26262 functional safety automotive spice.
Science skills is a collection of highly optimized skills that radically speed up agentic scientific workflows. Plug it
into your agent and it instantly gets heavily grounded programmatic access to over 30 massive scientific databases.
Alpha Genome, the Alphafold database, Unipro. Your agent autonomously queries complex protein structures or cross references rare genetic mutations.
Codeex complexity optimizer is a skill focused on safe readonly codebased complexity analysis. Install it and your
AI assistant transforms into a ruthless senior staff level performance engineer.
Hunts down cyclatic complexity, identifies memory bottlenecks, flags security vulnerabilities, generates a structured optimization report telling you exactly where and why to refactor.
Waits for your explicit approval before editing a single line.
Tired of reexplaining your workflow and past bugs to AI agents every morning?
Yansu's skill is the cure for AI amnesia? Yansu is a background AI that silently observes how you work on your desktop. Conversations, tool choices,
hesitations, decisions, crystallizes them into structured, reusable tribal knowledge. This skill.md dropin bridges
Yansu's memory backend directly into clawed code or cursor.
AI coding agents write clean code with zero compliance awareness. They'll log passwords and expose PII without hesitation. Compliance skills by Sprinto
open sources their internal SOCK 2 ISO 27,01 and HIPPA knowledge as a clawed code skill. The PI detector fires
autonomously in the background. Agent writes a GDPR violation. It intercepts and forces a rewrite before it ships.
Mercury Skills is an open library of skill.mmd playbooks for AI coding agents. Drop a skill into your agent skills directory and it gains structured
expertise on demand. 12 plus categories covering development, front, backend, DevOps, AI and ML, security, product,
marketing, design, and business. Over 100 skills total. Copy a single skill or clone the whole library.
two agent skills for testing distributed systems properly, not just running a few integration tests and shipping. One skill reads the codebase, extracts the
product's actual claims, generates generates hypotheses tied to those claims, and writes a structured test plan with a coverage adequacy argument.
The second executes it fault injection, linearizability checking, 10-state verdicts, and blame classification down to SUT or environment.
If you're tired of AI generated charts, drowning in grid lines, rainbow color scales, and 3D bars that lie about the
data, this is for you. Tuft Claude skill distills all three of Edward Tuy's books into 10 rules and auto applies them
every time you ask Claude code to make a chart. Data Inc. ratio, lie factor, kill list, chart selection, a 12 item
checklist. Nine before and after pairs in the repo show exactly what changes.
This one's a research paper turned open-source framework. Mm. Skills gives visual desktop agents reusable multimodal procedural knowledge. Each
skill bundles a skill.md runtime state cards and visual key frames. At inference time, the main agent keeps only lightweight skill hints in context,
then opens a temporary branch when task state suggests a skill applies.
Someone packaged Boris Churnney's Claude code pro tips. Talk into an agent skill.
Tell it what you want Claude cursor or chat GPT to do and it writes the prompt using five principles straight from that
talk. Keep it short. Lead with make a plan first. Anchor the model in existing code rather than redescribing it. Give
it a feedback loop and put persistent context in files, not the prompt.
PMBrain is a clawed code skill that gives product managers a local second brain. No vector DB, no cloud, just
plain markdown in a folder. feed it interview transcripts, meeting notes, or notion exports. It writes to knowledge,
hypothesis, decisions, and stakeholders, and tags every claim with a provenence marker so you can see whether something is documented, verbal, or a hunch.
This one's a bit different. A pastry chef with 18 years in professional kitchens built a claude code sub aent for baking. Search a bilingual French
and Chinese recipe library by name or ingredient. Calculate baker's percentages, scale any formula to a target batch size, and ask technique
questions about ganache ratios, moose stability, hydrocoloid selection, and more.
[music]
